offers.title: Klook
offers.description:
Klook is how you can find joyful experiences for anytime, anywhere.

Looking for fun things to do nearby? The best weekend getaway deals? Or just need to get from A to B when you're traveling? Klook is all of this and more. Best of all, everything's a few taps away.

offers.title: Villa Select – Your Perfect Villa Holiday
offers.description:
Villa Select – the Villa Holiday Specialists.
We’ve been helping people to enjoy villa getaways for over 40 years, so we’re the experts when it comes to finding the perfect holiday home for you! Each of our villas has been carefully handpicked for its individual character and style to ensure we find you the perfect villa to suit your personal needs, tastes and wants. From cosy villas perfect for couples to huge countryside retreats with space enough for the ultimate family holiday, whatever you’re looking for we are confident we’ll find the right place for you. What’s more, our Travel Specialists endeavour to visit every villa in our collection, ensuring that when you call us to find out more, you’ll be given first-hand knowledge and personal recommendations. So, whichever type of holiday villa you choose; near or far, big or small, we guarantee that you’ll enjoy those same levels of Villa Select service, which we hope are second to none.

offers.title: Lounge Pass
offers.description:
Pre bookable one time lounge access essential for getting a trip off to a great start. Enjoy the experience of VIP travel – book an airport lounge with Lounge Pass from as little as £13.50 per person. With 800 airport VIP lounges worldwide, you can add an extra touch of luxury to your next trip and make the travel experience a whole lot better.

Cancellations are permitted until 24 hours before the lounge visit.

offers.title: Beds Online Store
offers.description:
Beds and mattresses are essential purchases,
With a wide selection catering to various budgets and lifestyles, there's something for every customer,
Finding the bed of your dreams is easy with Beds Online,
Our extensive selection of high quality, stylish beds lets you find the perfect sleep solution for you, your family and your home.

offers.title: Dizzy Duck Designs
offers.description:
Dizzy Duck Designs is a UK designer, producer & supplier of home decorating stencils, decals and vinyl prints that are sold worldwide.  We have experienced consistent growth with improved production and new cutting and printing machines. We are investing in our future.  Our stencils are made from high quality 190micron Mylar® polyester sheets, are washable and reusable making stenciling a cost effective way to decorate. As we develop our printed product ranges we will have a growing range of peel and stick products for even easier home decor ideas.

We put great emphasis on customer care and satisfaction and are always developing new designs.

15% discount when 2 or more products are added to cart.

offers.title: Micucci Interiors
offers.description:
Micucci Interiors
offer an exclusive range of designer home accessories, dinnerware, lighting and fine art.
Although we tend to specialise in accessories, we sometimes incorporate very special and unique pieces into our collection, resulting in an eclectic mix rather than a uniform style.
We travel around Europe and the rest of the world to source new exciting pieces that we regularly add to our collection.

offers.title: Moostar
offers.description:
Moostar is a UK bathroom brand built on a simple idea: the toilet brush hadn't really changed in decades, so we redesigned it.
Our flagship product, the Soap Push, is a 304 stainless steel toilet brush with a built-in soap reservoir.
One push dispenses cleaning liquid straight onto the brush, so every clean is quicker, fresher and more hygienic.

The Soap Push has been independently recognised with three approvals:

• Good Housekeeping Institute Approved 2026
• GoodHomes Approved
• woman&home Reader Approved

offers.title: Ozaiz
offers.description:
OZAIZ is a luxury homeware and fragrance brand built on intentional living, sustainability, and timeless design.
We create refillable, multifunctional pieces that move seamlessly through daily rituals, offering customers more than just décor, they’re investing in beauty that is meant to live with them.

offers.title: Rugs Direct 2U
offers.description:
Rugs Direct 2U is a division of Carpets Direct 2U Ltd, a well established, family owned and run flooring specialist business based in the West Midlands.
Benefitting from four generations of retail experience, we have established a reputation for providing customers with good service and quality floor coverings priced to suit everyone's pocket.
We are one of the leading independent carpet and rug sellers in the UK and are trusted and respected by customers and suppliers alike.
We have rugs to suit all tastes and budgets from stunning retro designs to timeless classical styles from our traditional collection.
We offer a wide variety of colours, sizes and styles with materials ranging from luxurious wool to durable manmade fibres. 
We aim to provide quality rugs at competitive prices.
As an established retailer, we are able to negotiate discounts with our suppliers and pass on these savings to our customers.

offers.title: Sewing Online
offers.description:
For over 10 years Sewing Online has been supplying sewing accessories and needlecrafts across the UK and internationally around the world.
We are now the leading distributor of sewing and craft items within the UK, providing our customers with an exceptional range of products and first class customer service.

The Last Word in Sewing Supplies

Sewing Online is the UK’s favourite online destination for all your sewing needs, bringing you the best brands at the lowest prices.
We stock a large array of haberdashery, ribbons, trimmings, craft, cross stitch kits, patchwork, quilting, equipment, machine sewing accessories and much more, all in an easy to navigate website.

We buy from all over the world to give our customers the best products we can find – and every one of them at a competitive price.

offers.title: Sophos Lifestyle
offers.description:
At Sophos, we invite you to embark on a journey through time, discovering a world of curated contemporary lifestyle products designed to enrich your everyday experiences and elevate those special moments worth celebrating.
Our mission is to stand as your trusted source for high-quality, functional products that transcend fleeting fashion trends and truly stand the test of time.
Over the years, our product range has evolved, but our unwavering commitment to delivering excellence has remained unchanged.
We are a family-run business with a rich heritage of craftsmanship and dedication.

offers.title: The Pink Pig
offers.description:
The Pink Pig produces the largest range of sketchbooks,scrapbooks and notebooks in the UK. 
Established in 1992, Pink Pig International products are made in Great Britain and branded with the Made in Britain recognised marque.  We have over 25 years of experience hand assembling a catalogue comprising of a huge - 11,000+ products. 
These beautifully made products include sketchbooks, scrapbooks, notebooks and drawing books. 
Our large range has been shaped & crafted using the knowledge of our experts and most importantly by customers and consumers for over a quarter-century.

offers.title: Urban Bar
offers.description:
Urban Bar – Premium Glassware & Barware for Professionals and Enthusiasts
Urban Bar is a leading international provider of high-quality glassware and barware, serving the hospitality industry, top spirits brands, and consumers worldwide.
Established in 1983 by Richard Andrews, a former buyer for Liberty and Heals, Urban Bar has spent over four decades refining its craftsmanship to meet the highest standards of design, functionality, and durability.

What Makes Urban Bar Unique?

Premium Quality & Craftsmanship – Designed for professionals, tested for durability, and crafted to enhance the drinking experience.
Trusted by Global Brands – We collaborate with leading spirits companies and hospitality venues.
Bespoke & Branded Products – Custom glassware and bar tools for businesses looking to stand out.
Sustainable Approach – Focused on eco-friendly materials and long-lasting products.
Diverse Product Range – From cocktail shakers and strainers to elegant tumblers and gin balloons, we provide everything needed for a top-tier bar setup.
